# `xml_fmt`

XML rows for the partner bridge. Column names are used as element names.

Usage: `from textkit.formats.xml_fmt import render`

Sample output:

```
<rows>
  <row><sku>W-1</sku><name>Widget</name><qty>3</qty></row>
  <row><sku>G-2</sku><name>Gadget, large</name><qty></qty></row>
</rows>
```
